notes.title: hey, you found my notes
notes.body:
welcome to the notes app — this one's actually live.

this window reads a file straight out of my github repo, so when i edit it (sometimes from my phone), whatever i write shows up here without a redeploy. think of it as the sticky notes on my monitor, except you're allowed to read them.

poke around the rest of the dock while you're here.

notes.title: what i'm up to
notes.body:
building enterprise integrations at endeavor and finishing my MCS at UIUC (dec '26).

current obsessions: agentic runtimes, event-driven pipelines, and making this website feel like an operating system.

notes.title: about this site
notes.body:
no scrolling allowed. everything is a window — drag them, resize them, stack them.

built with next.js + framer-motion. the windows spring out of their dock icons because i think software should be a little gooey.

ps: there's a terminal in the dock now. type `help`. maybe try `sudo make coffee`.
